description_en: Remove agent accounts from a skill group by specifying the skill group and agent IDs
description_zh: 通过指定技能组及坐席ID，从技能组移除坐席账号
name: RemoveAgentFromSkillGroup

parameters.help_en:
The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Skill group ID.  

You can invoke the QuerySkillGroups (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/aiccs/developer-reference/api-aiccs-2019-10-15-queryskillgroups) API and view the SkillGroupId in the response parameters to obtain the skill group ID.
parameters.help_zh:
技能组ID。

可调用QuerySkillGroups (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/aiccs/developer-reference/api-aiccs-2019-10-15-queryskillgroups)接口，查看返回参数的SkillGroupId，即技能组ID
parameters.name: skill_group_id
